# Calibrating the projections

```{r}
res <- countryside_sar(
  data = mydata,
  crs = 3763,
  method = "circles",
  radius = 2000 * 1:10,
  habitat = myraster,
  habitat_names = c("Forest", "Agriculture", "Shrubland"),
  habitat_codes = 1:3,
  classification = myclassif,
  groups = "Forest",
  seed = 123
)
```
